youtube.aciklama: Before a cochlear implant evaluation, it is documented that the devices are fitted correctly and used enough. In the example case, data logging showed the devices were on for an average of ten hours a day, and the fitting had been verified with the RECD measured on the infant; limited progress was not due to insufficient use. If data logging is low, the problem is first solved with the family; low use should not be confused with insufficient benefit.
